contract.decoder: strict UTF-8; reject NUL; no BOM removal, normalization, or newline rewriting
contract.encoder: cl100k_base encode_ordinary; special-token spellings are ordinary text
contract.fragments: each full file and each contiguous SKILL fragment encoded independently; no wrapper, separator, or chat overhead
contract.eager: raw name/description top-level field lines including indented continuation lines; YAML syntax retained
contract.activation: remaining frontmatter including delimiters, and exact body after closing delimiter
contract.lazy: every other file below closest enclosing literal SKILL.md directory; references/scripts/assets/other by first relative path component
contract.outside_skills: repo_other; excluded from per-skill loading totals, included in whole-repository file counts
contract.dedup: per-file occurrences retained by repo/full pin/path; separate unique totals by complete file SHA256, never name
contract.coverage: missing/ambiguous raw fields or non-UTF8/NUL file yields NOT_RUN for complete facet; measured file receipts retained
contract.semantics: raw text inventory, not a YAML interpretation, actual loader trace, model context charge, or evaluation

dependency_note: regex wheel retained and verified; requests downloader is not imported or called; direct Encoding avoids network and plugin discovery
